metadata.title: Stable Rigidity in the Heisenberg Groups
metadata.abstract: For $n\ge2$, we prove that the $C^2$ boundary of a bounded nonempty open set in $\mathbb H^n$ is volume-preserving stable if and only if it is a Pansu sphere up to left translation and Heisenberg dilation. The proof combines centre reconstruction with a volume-constrained test field derived from Pansu dilation. Consequently, every isoperimetric region admitting an open representative with $C^2$ boundary is a Pansu ball up to these symmetries.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 高维 Heisenberg 保体积稳定刚性
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明 n≥2 时有界非空区域的 C² 边界保体积稳定，当且仅当其为平移与 Heisenberg dilation 下的 Pansu 球；因此具 C² 代表的等周区域为 Pansu 球。
analysis.breakthrough: 从稳定性分类推得光滑等周区域的唯一形状。
analysis.limitations: C² 边界假设不能直接应用于尚未证明正则的有限周长等周集。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者确定几何框架、解释及证明策略；ChatGPT 5.6 Sol 在作者引导下辅助定理 1.1 证明中的计算和中间推导，作者重推、核验并大量修订。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.03900v1 · PDF 第 3 页，AI Usage Statement
